November 19

Happy birthday, Simbo.

A small card, made only for you. Take your time with it.

Dear Simbo,

Another year, and I still think about how lucky I am to have you. You have a way of making ordinary days feel lighter, and you do it without trying.

I don't say it often enough, so I'm putting it here: thank you. For the laughs, for being honest with me, and for being someone I can be completely myself around.

I hope this year is gentle with you and generous too. I hope you get the rest you've earned, the good news you've been waiting on, and plenty of days where nothing needs fixing.

Happy birthday. I'm cheering for you, today and every day after.

With love, your friend

Three wishes for your year

  • Rest that actually helpsThe kind that leaves you light when you wake up.
  • Good news, right on timeEverything you're hoping for, arriving without making you wait too long.
  • People who show upThe way you always do for everyone else.

You are loved, Simbo.

Meskel daisies bloom around now. Fitting, for a birthday in November.
